errorSummary: Hardened trace MCP startup on Windows so health checks also verify live KAG tool registration. ensure-mcp-server now inspects tools/list for kag.record_agent_run and kag.ingest_memory_directory, restarts stale listeners when needed, and kag:ingest now self-heals by spawning the MCP server before flushing pending JSONL. Verified the helper reports healthy and kag:ingest completes successfully.
researchNotes: The stale-process issue was a live trace-mcp-server answering /health while serving an old tool table. The fix verifies the live registry before declaring readiness, which prevents kag:ingest from failing against a stale process.
